d:
"Two very broken pokemon resolve their differences by fucking each other's brains out." - BuiTales

"I'm sure it'll wash right off!

Had a lot of fun with this piece! Been a while since I've done any sort of sequence, hehe. Not too much experimental in here otherwise - messed around a bit with the goop, as well as the perspective and framing, but that's about it! Went for a semi-lined look, which fits Buizel pretty well I think. Idea loosely inspired by this story, by the appropriately-named buizelfucker! And just for the record, you can totally tell it's a Sceptile from the same-coloured leaf things and the red stripe, hehe." - Metalisk
